hook: Why Adam beats SGD on transformers, still unexplained.
hookText: Why Adam beats SGD on transformers, still unexplained

beats.say: Nearly every large language model trains with Adam or AdamW, yet the reason Adam beats SGD so decisively is still not fully explained.
Adam tracks bias-corrected moving averages of the gradient and its square, and AdamW separates weight decay from the adaptive update.
A study of more than one thousand three hundred language models found signed momentum closes ninety-six percent of the perplexity gap, at a twenty-five percent slowdown.
